name: Rabbitfolk
body:
These mammalian humanoids are known for their vibrant energy, natural curiosity, and seeming ability to always get themselves both into and out of danger.

Physical

Rabbitfolk are lean, athletic humanoids with distinctly rabbit-like features. They have large eyes, small mouths, and long ears—sometimes up to a foot in length. These ears may stand upright, hang loosely to the side of their head, or fall somewhere in-between.

Their fur is usually black, white, gray, brown, or some combination of these colors. However, stranger shades have been noted, especially in areas where rabbitfolk have been strongly influenced by their fey neighbors.

Rabbitfolk have long feet and plantigrade leg structures (walking with their feet flat on the ground), but run with a digitigrade gait (on their toes only). This helps provide them with incredible reflexes and bursts of speed.

Rabbitfolk stand about 4 feet tall on average, although their long ears may extend another foot or so beyond this. They are typically very lean, although body types vary just as in humans. Most rabbitfolk take an interest in fashion, adopting the latest trends and developing styles all their own.

Social

Rabbitfolk traditionally dwell in multi-family warrens built in underground burrows built in forest and hill country. These warrens are always well-defended from attack, with several exits available for retreat. Distrustful of strangers, they keep the location of these burrow villages secret at all cost. However, not all rabbitfolk dwell in warrens.

Many are more cosmopolitan, dwelling in human or other humanoid cities. Some of these urban areas have entire rabbitfolk neighborhoods, while in others rabbitfolk are only beginning to become known.

Rabbitfolk new to an area are skilled at creating “found families” and always seem to fit in no matter where they are.

Alignment and Religion

Very few rabbitfolk are Evil, as they place high priority on the well-being of their friends, neighbors, and community at large.

In matters of Law and Chaos, they seem to be evenly split, with many finding a happy balance between their desire for individuality and their need to conform to the expectations of their group.

Rabbitfolk have their own small pantheon of deities, including gods of agriculture, fertility, protection, and commerce. In addition, they often “borrow” gods that interest them from humans, elves, and others, fully incorporating them into their worship practices. To a rabbitfolk, it can never hurt to have too many gods looking out for you!

Names

Some typical rabbitfolk names include the following (choose or roll 1d20):

Blackberry
Bramble
Buster
Clover
Coynin
Dewdrop
Fluffy
Gyaer
Glory
Hodgepodge
Lago
Lep
Lucky
Peeta
Red
Skips
Stomper
Summer
Thistledown
Ziggy
Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are quick and perceptive, but physically lean. Your ability score modifiers are +2 Dex, +2 Cha, –2 Str [standard]. (0)
Size Special. At character creation, choose either Medium or Small size. As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size. As a Small creature, you have a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a +1 size bonus to your Armor Class, a –1 size penalty to your CMB, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks; you must use smaller weapons than Medium creatures. As a Medium or Small creature, you occupy a space of 5 feet by 5 feet, and your reach is 5 feet. (0)
Type Humanoid. You are a Humanoid with the rabbitfolk subtype. (0)
Speed Your base speed is 30 feet. (0)
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, and Halfling. (0)
Other Traits
Fleet-Footed You receive Run as a bonus feat and a +2 species bonus on initiative checks. (3)
Keen Senses You receive a +2 species bonus on Perception checks. (2)
Senses Low-light vision. You can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. You retain the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions. (1)
Lucky Reflexes You gain a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class. (2)
Tactical Hop Once per day, as a swift action, you can make a long jump up to half your speed without provoking attacks of opportunity. You must have a path with obstacles no higher than 2/3 your height, and you must be able to land in an unoccupied space. You cannot use this ability if you are immobilized, unconscious, or otherwise unable to take a swift action. (2)
Total: 10 RP (standard)
Alternate Species Traits
Acrobatic You gain a +2 species bonus on all Acrobatics checks. This trait replaces keen senses.
Arctic Hare You come from a cold, arid climate. You gain Endurance as a bonus feat. When in conditions of severe cold, you have to attempt Fortitude saves only once per hour instead of once every 10 minutes. In addition, you gain a +4 bonus to Stealth checks when in snowy, icy, or other arctic terrain. This trait replaces fleet-footed.
Clever Your mind is as energetic as your body, constantly grasping new ideas and tinkering with new concepts. You gain a +2 bonus to Intelligence instead of +2 to Charisma. This trait alters ability score modifiers.
Compression Rabbitfolk raised in warrens are used to maneuvering through tight spaces. You have the compression universal monster ability, allowing you to move through an area as small as one-quarter your space without squeezing or one-eighth your space when squeezing. This trait replaces tactical hop.
Desert Hare You come from a hot, arid climate. You gain Endurance as a bonus feat. When in conditions of severe heat, you have to attempt Fortitude saves only once per hour instead of once every 10 minutes. In addition, you gain a +4 bonus to Stealth checks when in desert terrain. This trait replaces fleet-footed.
Jumper You are always considered to have a running start when making Acrobatics checks to jump. This trait replaces tactical hop.
Lucky Instincts You gain a +1 species bonus on all saving throws. This trait replaces lucky reflexes.
Serene You are more level-headed than most rabbitfolk, approaching life with a sense of calm and balance than most of your kin cannot fathom. You gain a +2 bonus to Wisdom instead of +2 to Charisma. This trait alters ability score modifiers.
Weapon Familiarity You are proficient with halberds, longbows and shortbows (including composite bows), and short swords. If you already have proficiency with all martial weapons, you instead Exotic Weapon Proficiency as a bonus feat. This trait replaces tactical hop.
Species Feats
Additional Hop

You are adept at hopping in combat.

Prerequisites: rabbitfolk.

Benefit: You can use your tactical hop species ability one additional time per day.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time, you gain one additional use of your tactical hop ability.

Favored Class Bonuses
Barbarian Add +1 foot to the your base speed. In combat this option has no effect unless you have selected it five times (or another increment of five). This bonus stacks with the barbarian’s fast movement class feature and applies under the same conditions as that feature.
Bard Add +1 to your total number of bardic performance rounds per day.
Cleric Select one domain power granted at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier. Add +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that domain power.
Druid Add a +1/4 luck bonus to your animal companion’s saving throws.
Fighter Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a dirty trick or trip attempt.
Mesmerist When casting mesmerist enchantment spells, add +1/2 to the effective caster level of the spell, but only to determine the spell’s duration.
Monk Add +1 to your CMD when resisting a grapple or trip attempt.
Paladin Add +1/2 hit point to your lay on hands ability (whether using it to heal or harm).
Ranger Choose a weapon from the following list: halberd, longbow, shortbow, or short sword. Add +1/2 on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using that weapon (maximum bonus of +4). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
Rogue Add a +1/2 bonus on Acrobatics checks to jump and a +1/2 bonus on Sense Motive checks.
Swashbuckler Increase the number of times per day you can use charmed life by +1/4.
